title: Mobs & Mines V2
description: A vanilla+ expansion that has little clutter and focuses around the Dungeon now Loading mod.
body:
# 🦎Mobs and Mines V2
**is a Vanilla+ exploration modpack that revolves around [Dungeon now Loading](https://modrinth.com/mod/dungeon-now-loading). There is very little feature bloat but still a good dose of modded content. It also runs nicely.**

- ⚔️ Expore expansive dungeons from [Dungeon now Loading](https://modrinth.com/mod/dungeon-now-loading)!
- ⛏️ Discover reworked caves courtesy of [Galosphere](https://modrinth.com/mod/galosphere)!
- 🐸 Threaten new wildlife such as the [Gipples](https://modrinth.com/mod/gipples-galore), [Friends & Foes](https://modrinth.com/mod/friends-and-foes) and [Ribbits](https://modrinth.com/mod/ribbits)!
- 🏔️ Revamped world generation thanks to [Geophillic](https://modrinth.com/datapack/geophilic)
- 🏰 A few more Vanilla+ structures by [Explorify](https://modrinth.com/datapack/explorify)!
- 🔥 Reworked nether courtesy of [Hearths](https://modrinth.com/datapack/hearths), [Soulful Nether](https://modrinth.com/mod/soulfulnether) and mine new ruby ore from [Rubinated Nether](https://modrinth.com/mod/rubinated-nether)!

**You can view a full mod list by going to [versions](https://modrinth.com/modpack/mobs-mines-v2/changelog) and viewing it's dependecies.**

please enable all RPs when you first load the modpack

Subscribe to my [Youtube](https://www.youtube.com/@Whisdan)! 📺

Join our [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/vaJ6acEqtX)! 📎

Looking for the Legacy version of M&M? Find it [here](https://modrinth.com/modpack/mobs-mines). 💀

This project will be unlisted once [Cradle of the Hosts](https://modrinth.com/project/vkhv3KsD) is released.
